## Problem/Motivation

Describe the problem or use case that motivates this feature request.

## Proposed Solution

A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.

## Alternatives Considered

Describe any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## Additional Context

Add any other context, mockups, or examples about the feature request here.

## Benefit

Who benefits from this feature? How does it improve the project?

- **Users:** [e.g. faster processing, better UX]
- **Developers:** [e.g. easier testing, cleaner code]
- **Project:** [e.g. better maintainability, new capabilities]
